title: Research Reference Organizer — Overview and definition
body: Public edition. Public tool knowledge, fact-checked reference. Tracks sources, notes, quotations, and page numbers for research projects. The Research Reference Organizer tracks sources, notes, quotations, and page numbers. Every source gets a card with full citation details, the student's notes, exact quotations with page numbers, and tags for which chapter or argument each item supports. When writing starts, the organizer feeds the right quotes to the right sections.
capabilities: Store sources with full citation details
Attach notes and exact quotations with pages
Tag items by chapter or argument
Feed quotes to the right writing sections
Export the organized reference set

demo.title: Core operation executed
demo.code: const docs=[{id:1,text:'spaced repetition improves recall'},{id:2,text:'massed practice is weaker'},{id:3,text:'sleep aids memory'}];const hits=docs.filter(d=>d.text.includes('repetition')).map(d=>d.id);J({hits});assert(JSON.stringify(hits)==='[1]','search');
